mapper.sql: CASE WHEN e.category = 'CHEST' OR e.name REGEXP '체스트|벤치 프레스|펙 덱' THEN 'CH' WHEN e.category = 'BACK' OR e.name REGEXP '랫 풀|로우|등 운동' THEN 'BA' WHEN e.category = 'SHOULDER' OR e.name REGEXP '숄더|레터럴' THEN 'SH' WHEN e.category = 'LEG' OR e.name REGEXP '레그|스쿼트|핵 스쿼트' THEN 'LG' WHEN e.category = 'ARM' OR e.name REGEXP '컬|트라이셉스|암 머신' THEN 'AR' WHEN e.category = 'CARDIO' OR e.category = '유산소' OR e.name REGEXP '트레드밀|사이클|스텝밀' THEN 'CA' WHEN e.category = 'MULTI' OR e.name REGEXP '스미스|케이블|펑셔널' THEN 'MU' WHEN e.category = 'FREE_WEIGHT' OR e.name REGEXP '파워 랙|덤벨|바벨' THEN 'FW' ELSE 'EQ' END
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'AVAILABLE'), 0) AS available_count, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'INSPECTION'), 0) AS inspection_count, COALESCE(SUM(status IN ('REPAIR', 'UNAVAILABLE')), 0) AS repair_count FROM equipment

SELECT e.id AS equipment_id, CONCAT(, '-', LPAD(e.id, 3, '0')) AS management_code, e.name, e.category, e.location, e.status, DATE(MAX(ml.performed_at)) AS last_maintenance_date, MIN(CASE WHEN ml.next_due_date >= CURRENT_DATE THEN ml.next_due_date END) AS next_due_date FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN equipment_maintenance_logs ml ON ml.equipment_id = e.id
AND (e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CONCAT(, '-', LPAD(e.id, 3, '0')) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND e.category = #{category} AND e.status = #{status}
GROUP BY e.id, e.name, e.category, e.location, e.status ORDER BY CASE e.status WHEN 'REPAIR' THEN 0 WHEN 'INSPECTION' THEN 1 WHEN 'UNAVAILABLE' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, e.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment (name, category, location, status, purchased_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{category}, #{location}, 'AVAILABLE', #{purchasedAt})
